import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 40

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/


namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture40

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α] (G : SimpleGraph α)

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 40](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a nontrivial connected graph `G` the size `f(G)` of a largest induced forest
satisfies `f(G) ≥ ceil((p(G) + b(G) + 1)/2)` where `p(G)` is the path cover
number and `b(G)` is the largest induced bipartite subgraph size.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture40 (h_conn : G.Connected) (h_nontrivial : 1 < Fintype.card α) :
    ⌈(((pathCoverNumber G : ℝ) + b G + 1) / 2)⌉ ≤  G.largestInducedForestSize := by
  sorry

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture40

review.notes: The sole theorem faithfully states Conjecture 40. The source explicitly requires a simple connected graph on more than one vertex and gives f(G) ≥ CEIL[(p(G)+b(G)+1)/2]. Its glossary agrees with all three Lean invariants. The cardinality hypothesis is redundant with [Nontrivial α], not an additional restriction. Scratch proofs verified that path-cover minima and induced-forest maxima are attained, checked boundary behavior, and proved the inequality for K₂ without invoking conjecture40. Computable bipartite-size tests and a Lean equivalence with p+b+1 ≤ 2f also passed. The live site was unavailable; the recovered July 26, 2026 archive marks this conjecture O (open), consistent with the category.
